Create a dense ruined Greco-Roman sanctuary around a long sunken courtyard dominated by a massive twisted, moss-covered dead tree. Arrange monumental temples and roofless colonnaded halls around the court, facing inward across stairs, raised walkways, bridges, and narrow passages. Use weathered cream and ochre sandstone, fluted columns, arches, carved entablatures, broken walls, and partially buried chambers. Cover the ground with cracked stone paving, damp stains, weeds, and fallen masonry. Scatter column fragments and rotting beams around the ruins. Hang chains and skull ornaments from the tree and place candles, bones, pottery, and offerings around its roots, with amber firelight and cool turquoise glows.
